title: Weird elevators or escalators
content: Just woke up from a dream of mall world where I was trying to move to a lower floor. I asked one of the staff which escalator was going down and pointed me towards the opposite one which I didn’t really understand lol. I eventually get on the escalator, which at first looked like those moving escalator sidewalks you see in real life. I went on and for some reason it changed into more of a floating elevator platform with no walls. I was holding on tight to some machinery, in case I would fall. For some reason the elevators turned into almost a train/rollercoaster and I was on it with other people. We were going upwards even though I asked the worker how to go down to the lower levels. As we were all going up, the train of elevators started curving like a spiral, there was a man on the top who looked like he was maneuvering our elevators/escalators. These are literally just floating platforms, no walls, no seatbelts. The man controlling our train of platforms went “oops!” And the center part of our train slightly crashed. People fell on top of each other, and a lady almost fell off, but luckily she was able to lay on some beams. My sister and I were on it and I remember screaming “OMG OMG OMG” until it was resolved. That’s all I remember, I think we all ended up okay just crashed for a bit. Has anyone else ever experienced something like this?
